tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i dmar 'khrid 'khyer bde kun phan zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣ+tā ya/ thub dbang dam pa mi pham 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /klu sgrub zhabs dang thogs med a ti sha /'brom ston kun mkhyen btsong kha ba la sogs/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ /de la 'dir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar rim par brgyud pa'i byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid dmigs dam pa'i man ngag bzhin nyams len du 'khyer bde mdor bsdus dgod pa la gsum/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi/ mjug go /dang po la gnyis/ sngon gro skyabs sems dang*/ dngos gzhi bshes gnyen bsten tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ gnas khang byi dor byas te sku gsung thugs kyi rten bkram/ mchod pa legs par bshams la/ thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i dkon mchog gsum po thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar mngon sum du byon nas bzhugs par gyur ces brjod dam/ min kyang de'i mos pa shugs can bya/ rang bzhin spyi dang khyad par bdag nyid thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar 'khor ba dang ngan song gsum du sdug bsngal mi bzad pa myong zhing*/ da dung yang myong bar 'gyur ba'i tshul dran par byas te/ yid skyo zhing 'jigs pa'i blo shugs drag po dang khyed mkhyen snyam pa'i re bltos 'cha' ba'i yid gtad kyi blo lings skyur gyi sgo nas de dag gi yon tan dran bzhin par ngag tu/ bdag sogs 'gro ba thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= /dam pa'i chos rnams la= /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la=/ bdun nam nyer gcig brgya stong sogs ci nus brjod pa'i bar skabs rnams su'am mthar/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud la skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa rnams myur du skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes lan bdun nam nyer gcig sogs brjod cing*/ 'dir mi gsal yang de'i tshe skyabs gnas de dag gi sku las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa byung ste/ rang gi spyi bo sogs su zhugs nas nyes pa'i tshogs ma lus pa dag song snyam du bsams na'ang khyad che bar sems/ de nas sems bskyed pa ni/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du myur ba myur bar yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa rnams nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum sogs don dran bzhin pas brjod/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ bsam pa dang*/ sbyor bas bsten tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis/ rtsa ba dad pa sbyang ba dang*/ bka' drin dran pa'i sgo nas gus pa bskyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyud las/ slob dpon gyi ni yon tan bzung*/ /skyon ni nam yang bzung mi bya/ /yon tan bzung na dngos grub thob/ /skyon rnams bzung na dngos mi 'grub/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bla ma la dad pa skye ba la thog mar de la skyon rtog gi blo 'gog dgos te/ de ma bkag na dad pa tshul bzhin du mi skye la/ de ma skyes na rang la tshe 'di phyi thams cad du legs tshogs 'byung ba'i sgo 'gags nas 'dug cing*/ khyad par tshe phyi ma rnams su ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'phrad pa'i skal dang bral nas ngan 'gror ltung bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /des na rang la chos ston pa'i bla mas mtshon nas chos 'brel yod pa rnams legs par gsal btab ste/ bla ma de dag gi ngos nas skyon yod dam med kyang bla'i/ rang ngos nas skyon ltar snang ba'i cha rnams blo ngor 'char bcug la/ ga re bdag gi bla ma 'di la skyon 'di dag yod nas snang ngam/ med bzhin du snang snyam du rtog go /de'i tshe 'di snyam du bdag ni las ma dag pa'i dbang gis 'di dag la skyon yod pa ltar snang gi /bla ma sangs rgyas 'di la skyon ga la srid snyam du legs par bsam/

skyon med nas snang mi srid snyam na/ de ni srid de/ dper na/ 'khrul pa'i shes ngor dung dkar ser po/ gangs ri sngon por snang ba sogs dang*/ skyon kun zad kyi sangs rgyas de nyid kyang legs skar mu stegs byed sogs la skyon can du snang ba bzhin no snyam du bsam/ de ltar skyon rtog gi blo bkag nas dad pa la sbyang dgos te/ dad pa rnal ma skyes na bshes gnyen tshul bzhin du bsten pa 'byung bar ma zad/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba bla ma yin pa de bzhin du dad pa yang bde legs thams cad kyi rtsa bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bla ma de la mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan khyad par can yod na lta ci/ tha na'ang dngos zhen chung ba klog 'dzin bzang ba sogs yon tan phran tshegs yod pa rnams gsal btab ste/ bdag gi bla ma la yon tan 'di lta bu yod snyam du yang yang bsams nas sangs rgyas dang 'dra bar dad pa shugs can bskyed/ gnyis pa bka' drin dran nas gus pa bskyed pa ni/ spyir nam mkha' dang sems can gyi khams la mtha' med pa de bzhin du/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dpag tu med pa dag srid na'ang*/ de rnams kyi rang bzhin gyi sku dngos ni bdag cag lta bu skal ba dman pa'i mthong yul du 'gyur ba min la/ gal te 'gyur srid na'ang dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'dis ni rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob kyi rnam pas bdag la chos kyis phan btags pa las lhag pa'i don mdzad rgyu mi 'dug pas/ rang ngos nas bla ma 'di ni sangs rgyas de dag las kyang bka' drin bla lhag tu che bar nges/ chos bstan pa'i don bzhin rang gis bsgrub nus na sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang kyang ster ba'i phyir bka' drin 'di ni stong gsum gser gyis bkang yang gzhal nus pa min no snyam du bsam pa'i tshul gyis gus pa bskyed do/ /gnyis pa sbyor bas bsten tshul ni/ bsdu na bla ma mnyes pa ni sgo du ma nas bsgrub cing*/ mi mnyes pa cung zad kyang mi bsgrub par khrus dang sku mnye dril phyis sogs mus kyis bkur zhing ngag gis bstod pa dang*/

ci gsung bka' bzhin du bsgrub par bya/ de ltar mi nus na'ang ji snyam du mi 'jog par shad sbyang legs par bya ba la 'bad/ gtso bor sgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes par bya dgos kyang*/ rang nyid kyi tshogs bde blag tu rdzogs pa sogs kyi dgos pa khyad par can yod pas na zang zing gi dngos po gya nom pa sogs kyis mchod par bya'o/ /bla ma dngos su bsten bzhin pa'i tshe de ltar bya dgos la/ rang nyid gcig pu lta bus nyams su len pa'i skabs yin na/ bsnyen bkur spyi dang khyad par khrus sogs dngos su ma grub pa'i dod lta bur/ dngos brgyud kyi bla ma kun la thun mong du phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod pa sogs kyi lag len dmigs pas bya ba la/ thog mar/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs shing chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa dang*/ bdag gi dad mos kyi mthus sa gzhi rin po che'i rang bzhin bde ba can ltar dag cing phun sum tshogs par gyur cig /thams cad du ni sa gzhi dag zhes sogs dang*/ de'i dbus su rin po che'i seng ge'i khri rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma'i grangs dang mnyam pa bang rim gyi rnam pas bkod pa mdzes par grub par gyur cig /ces pas sa gzhi gdan khri bcas gsal gdab/ rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ zhes sogs dang*/ ma lus sems can sogs sh+lau ka gsum mam gcig gis skyabs yul rnams spyan drangs/ khrus kyi khang ba sogs kyis khrus khang bskyed/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus gsol/ stong gsum kun du sogs kyis dri bzang byug /srab 'jam yang ba sogs kyis gos 'bul/ bdag dang 'gro la sogs kyis bzhugs su gsol/ de nas yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba la/ thog mar phyag 'tshal ba ni/ 'dren pa mnyam med ston pa bcom ldan 'das/ nas rje'i bar brgyud rim gnyis lam rim gsol 'debs ltar la/

lhag ma ni 'jam dpal zhal lung bzhin te der ma zin pa ni blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde zhes pa'i 'phror/ sbyin pa rgya mtsho blo gros gzhan phan pa/ /rje btsun blo bzang sbyin par gsol ba 'debs/ /ces pa phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes par bsgyur ba dang*/ ji snyed su dag sogs kyis phyag 'tshal/ de nas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu so bdun ma gang lcogs dang bdun ma gang mang gi rjes su/ mchod yon phal cher sogs sam/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho sogs kyis chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo/ /'dzam bu gling dang gling zhes sogs dang*/ zhing 'dir sogs kyis 'dod yon lnga rgyal srid bdun dang*/ me tog dam pa sogs kyis bla na yod med kyi mchod pa rnams 'bul/ 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis bshags pa bya/ 'dir bshags pa'i tshig gzhan brjod kyang phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba las mi 'gal/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba nas thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi/ zhes pa'i bar gyis yan lag gzhan dang*/ de nas yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur drin can rje/ sogs kyis byin rlabs zhu/ yang na/ gong du bla brgyud kyi phyag 'tshal mdor bsdus zhig dang 'dir gsol 'debs rgyas pa byas te mthar yon tan kun gyi sogs sbyar na'ang legs/ mjug tu phyag 'tshal ba dang sogs bsngo smon ci rigs bya'o/ /de ltar nyams su len pa'i tshe thun ring thung dang grangs kyang skabs bstun gyis bya/ snga phyi dum bur bcad cing nyams su blangs chog pas stan thog gcig tu dmigs skor lhag ma rnams tshangs dgos pa'i nges pa med pas na/ dpe cha bshad sbyang byed pa ltar mjug gi bar du nges par 'don dgos pa yang min no/ /des na skabs gang yin gyi dmigs pa la dpyad sgom gtso bor bya zhing*/ 'jog sgom kyang bya dgos pa yang yod la/ shes na bris pa ltar byed par yang ma nges so/ /thun 'tshams su dngos gzhi'i skabs kyi dmigs rnam dran pa dang*/ bsag sbyang la gtso bor 'bad cing*/

bag yod bsten pa/ dbang po'i sgo sdom pa/ zas kyi tshod rig pa/ nam gyi thun stod smad du rnal 'byor la brtson pa sogs la bslab par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ dal 'byor la snying po len pa'i phyir du bskul ba dang*/ snying po ji ltar len tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum/ dal 'byor ngos bzung ba/ don che ba/ rnyed dka' bar bsam pa'o/ /dang po ni/ ngan 'gro gsum dang lha tshe ring po bzhi ni mi ma yin pa'i mi khom pa dang*/ mir skyes kyang glen lkug log lta can/ mtha' 'khob tu skyes pa/ rgyal ba'i bka' med pa'i sar skyes pa bzhi ni mir gyur pa'i mi khom pa ste/ de dang bral ba ni dal ba brgyad do/ /spyir mi yin pa/ sa tshig gam chos tshig gang rung gis phye ba'i yul dbus su skyes pa/ dbang po tshang ba/ las mtha' ma log pa/ gnas la dad pa lnga rang 'byor dang*/ sangs rgyas byon nam/ de'am de'i nyan thos kyis chos ston bzhin pa/ sgrub pa'i bstan pa ma nyams pa/ chos bstan pa nyams su blangs nas 'bras bu thob pa'i rjes su 'jug pa/ gzhan gyis snying brtse bar byed pa lnga gzhan 'byor yin pas de lta bu'i dal 'byor rang la tshang ma tshang dpyad pa'i tshe/ rang nyid mir skyes shing dkon mchog dang las 'bras la yid ches yod pa dang*/ gsung rab la thos bsam byed nus pa/ dbang bau tshang zhing 'tshams med ma byas pa/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon cing des chos gsungs pa gnas pa/ sbyin bdag sogs kyis mthun rkyen sbyor ba yang yod pas dal 'byor rnams don gyis tshang 'dug snyam nas dga' ba bsgom par bya'o/ /gnyis pa don che bar bsam pa ni/ lha klu lha min sogs 'gro ba gzhan gyi rten la mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'i las gsog pa'i nus pa mthu chung zhing*/ mi'i rten la las de dag gsog pa'i nus pa stobs che ba/ 'dzam bu'i gling pa las kya sa ba yin pas las dkar nag gang bsgrubs kyang stobs shin tu che/

khyad par dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi'i lus rten la ni/ mngon mtho dang nges legs nyan rang gi byang chub 'am/ kun mkhyen gyi go 'phang yang bsgrubs phyin 'grub par 'gyur bas/ ji skad du/ dal ba'i rten 'di yid bzhin nor las lhag /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bdag gi 'di lta bu'i rten thob pa ni rnyed pa legs par rnyed pa'o snyam du dga' ba shugs can bskyed/ des na rten 'di don med du mi btang bar snying po blang ba'i sgo nas don ldan du bya'o snyam du yang yang bsam/gsum pa rnyed dka' bar bsam pa la gsum/ dpe/ rgyu/ ngo bo'i sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'di lta bu'i rten ni/ da res stes dbang gis rnyed pa ma gtogs shin tu rnyed par dka' ste/ dper na gyang logs la sran ma gtor ba'i tshe chags srid pa dka' ba dang*/ rgya mtsho chen por g.yeng ba'i gnya' shing gi bu gar rus sbal gyi mgrin pa chud dka' ba dang*/ ngan 'gror 'gro ba ni sa chen po'i rdul dang mtshungs shing bde 'gror skye ba thub pa'i phyag sen gyi rtse mos bzhes pa'i rdul dang 'dra bar dkon par gsungs pa ltar ro snyam du bsam/ gnyis pa ni/ spyir bde 'gro tsam thob pa la yang tshul khrims rnam dag sna gcig yan chad bsrung dgos shing*/ khyad par dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten thob pa'i rgyur tshul khrims rnam par dag pas gzhi gzung*/ sbyin sogs kyis grogs byas/ smon lam dri ma med pas 'tshams sbyor ba sogs dgos na/ de ltar bsgrub pa dkon pas bdag gi spyod pa 'di lta bus dal 'byor shin tu rnyed par dka'o snyam du bsam mo/ /gsum pa ni/ dmyal ba las yi dwags/ de las kyang dud 'gro nyung zhing*/ de las ni mi'i 'gro ba shin tu nyung ba dbyar gyi srin bu'i grangs kyis shes la/ dal 'byor ma tshang ba'i mi'i 'gro ba nas kyi phung bau'i tshod du byas na/ de tshang ba ni nas rdog gcig gi grangs tshad ltar shin du dkon pa'o snyam du bsam/

mdor na/ bzhi brgya ba las/ phal mo cher na mi rnams ni/ /dam pa ma yin phyogs yongs 'dzin/ /de bas so so skye bo rnams/ /phal cher nges par ngan 'gror 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bdag kyang dal 'byor thob nas chos ma bsgrub na/ ngan 'gror 'gro bas rten 'di la da lta nas chos rnam dag cig bsgrub dgos snyam du nges pa shugs can bskyed par bya'o/ /gnyis pa snying bau ji ltar nyams su len pa la gsum/ skyes bu chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i lam dang*/ 'bring dang thun mong ba'i lam dang*/ chen po'i lam gyi rim pa la blo sbyang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ lam sgron las/ gang zhig thabs ni gang dag gis/ /'khor ba'i bde ba tsam dag la/ /rang nyid don du gnyer byed pa/ /skyes bu de ni tha mar shes/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'dir bstan pa'i skyes bu chung ngu'i lam nyams su len pa la gnyis/ 'jig rten phyi ma don gnyer gyi blo bskyed pa dang*/ phyi ma'i bde thabs bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa/ ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsam pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa ma bsams na tshe 'di'i snang shas kyi dbang du song nas phyi ma'i bde thabs bsgrub par mi 'gyur la/ de bsams na rang ngam shugs kyis phyi ma'i don du chos bsgrub pa la 'jug pa 'ong bas de bsam pa la gsum/ nges par 'chi ba/ nam 'chi cha med pa/ shi ba'i tshe chos ma gtogs gzhan gyis mi phan par bsam pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sngon byon pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems skye 'chi la dbang thob pa rnams kyang mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan cing*/ 'phags bod kyi paṇa grub dang rgyal blon sogs mdor na sngar 'di ma shi bar tshe thar bya ba ni gcig kyang med na/ bdag gcig pu lta ci/ de yang dus nges pa can gyi 'chi ba ni sngags rdzas sogs rkyen gang gis kyang bzlog tu med pas nges par 'chi/ /skyes tsam nyid nas nyi rgas grang so bzhin du mi sdod par nyin re zhag re bzhin 'chi bdag gi drung du rim gyis myur bar 'gro zhing*/

tshe zad pa la gsar snon ni cung zad med pas nges par 'chi/ byis pa'i dus su bsgrub 'dod mi skye zhing rgas pa'i tshe bsgrub mi nus/ bar skabs su lto gos sogs kyi ched dang*/ gnyid kyis g.yengs nas chos bsgrub pa'i long med bzhin par 'chi dgos par 'dug snyam du bsam/ gnyis pa nam 'chi cha med bsam pa la/ spyir sgra mi snyan pa ma gtogs gzhan rnams la tshe tshad bshad pa ltar thub pa'i nges pa med cing*/ khyad par 'dzam bu'i gling ba rnams ni bskal ba dang po'i dus su tshe lo dpag tu med la/ mthar tshe lo bcu la thug gi bar du 'gyur bas shin du yang ma nges/ da lta rang las rgas gzhon mang po zhig kyang go rim ma nges par shi ba ni mngon sum du gyur pas nam 'chi cha med/ phyi'i dgra gdon me chu sogs dang*/ nang gi 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i nad sogs 'chi rkyen ni shin du mang la/ gson rkyen zas sman mi 'phrod pa dang longs spyod sogs la brten nas 'thab rtsod lta bus kyang 'chi bas nam 'chi cha med/ sa chen po 'di ri rab dang bcas pa'ang 'jig par 'gyur srid na/ bdag gi lus phran bu 'di phyi nang gi rkyen cung zad tsam gyis kyang 'chi bar 'gyur bas de ring rang mi 'chi ba'i nges pa med pas nam 'chi cha ga la yod snyam du bsam/ gsum pa shi ba'i tshe chos ma gtogs gzhan gyis mi phan pa ni/ 'jig rten pha rol tu 'gro ba'i tshe/ gnyen grogs sogs gcig kyang 'khrid sa med/ nor gyi phung po yod kyang rdul tsam yang 'khyer du med/ tshe 'di'i phun tshogs gzhan lta ci/ rang gi lus 'di nyid kyang mal du cam gyis bzhag nas rnam shes gcig pu 'jig rten pha rol tu 'gro ba'i tshe/ phan pa ni dam pa'i chos las gzhan mi 'dug snyam du yang yang bsam ste/ nges par da lta nyid nas chos 'ba' zhig bya bar thag gcad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ rab tu tsha zhing grang ba yi/

/dmyal ba nyi ma gcig bzhin dran/ /bkres skom dag gis ring ba yi/ /yi dwags dag kyang dran par bya/ /rmongs pa'i sdug bsngal rab mang ba'i/ /byol song blta zhing dran par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsam dgos te/ ma bsams na de'i rgyu las mi ldog cing*/ de ma log na ni sdug bsngal myong ba las ma 'das pas so/ /des na ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsams na de la skrag pa 'byung zhing byung na de'i rgyu la 'dzem pa 'ong bas de zlog pa'i thabs skyabs 'gro sogs la 'bad par 'gyur ba sogs kyi dgos pa mang bas na bsam tshul ni/ de ltar 'chi ba zhig nges par 'ong la/ shi ba'i 'og tu rgyun chad nas mi 'gro bas 'gro ba gnyis gang rung zhig tu skye ba len par 'gyur ro/ /de yang dge ba'i las kyis bde 'gro dang mi dge ba'i las kyis ngan 'gror skye bar nges pas/ bdag gis ni ngan 'gro'i rgyu mi dge ba rgyal bau'i bang mdzod ltar mang du bsags shing gsog bzhin par 'dug la/ bde 'gro'i rgyu dge ba gdeng khel sna gcig kyang bsags pa mi snang*/ des na ngan song du skye ba las 'os mi 'dug pas/ der skyes pa'i tshe sdug bsngal myong tshul ni gzhan gyi sdug bsngal la phar blta ba lta bu'i shes pa kha phyir bltas kyis rang gi rgyud thog tu khel dka' bas na/ sdug bsngal de rang nyid kyis myong bar bsam par bya'o/ /'di la gsum/ dmyal ba/ dud 'gro/ yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa'o/ /dang po la/ tsha dmyal 'khor bcas dang*/ grang dmyal gyi sdug bsngal bsam tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ spyir dmyal ba rnams kyi sdug bsngal rim gyis myong dgos pa min na'ang*/ 'dir rim par bsgoms na myong ba thon pa la khyad che bas de ltar du bsam pa ni/ tsha dmyal brgyad ka'i 'og thams cad lcags bsregs kyis gzhi logs lcags bsregs kyi ra ba/ steng 'og phyogs 'tshams thams cad du me lce 'bar bas khyab par mtshungs pas/

de 'dra zhig gi nang du rang nyid da lta skyes par mos te/ brgyad kyi dang po yang sos ni/ dmyal ba der skyes pa'i tshe rang dang 'dra ba'i sems can mang po der tshogs te phan tshun gcig la gcig gis zhe sdang drag pos mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnun pa la brten nas/ lus tshal pa du mar song ste sa la 'gyel nas sdug bsngal myong ba na/ nam mkha' las khyed rnams yang sos par gyur cig ces pa'i sgra byung ba dang*/ yang sngar bzhin sos te phan tshun mtshon bsnun pa sogs kyis sdug bsngal khor yug tu myong bar bsam/ thig nag ni/ de nas bros pas dmyal ba'i srung ma dag gis bzung nas sa gzhi la gan rkyal du bskyel te lus la thig brgyad sogs btab nas mtshon rnon pos de bzhin du gshegs par byed/ bsdus 'joms ni/ yang bros pas dmyal srung rnams kyis rir lug glang seng gdong lta bu'i ri gnyis brdab pa'i bar du bcug nas btsir bas dbang po'i sgo thams cad nas khrag gi rgyun dmar chal gyis 'bab par byed/ ngu 'bod ni/ yang bros bas lcags kyi khang ba zhig tu sleb pa na sgo dbyer med du 'grig ste phyogs kun nas me lce 'bar bas bsreg cing da 'phrogs yang mi 'dug snyam nas ngu 'bod lhang lhang byed/ ngu 'bod chen po ni/ yang bros pa na lcags khang nyis rim du chud de snga ma bzhin bsreg cing*/ lcags khang nang ma nas thon srid kyang phyi ma nas mi thon pa'i dbang gis ngu 'bod chen po byed/ tsha ba ni/ yang bros pa na srung mas lcags kyi gsal shing me 'bar bas 'phong nas spyi bo'i bar du phug pas sgo thams cad nas me 'bar ba dang khro chu khol ma'i nang du 'tshod par byed/ rab tu tsha ba ni/ yang bros pas srung ma rnams kyis rab tu 'bar ba'i gsal shing rtse gsum pas 'phong nas phug ste rtse mo dbus ma spyi bo dang g.yas g.yon gnyis phrag pa nas thon pa dang*/ lcags bsregs leb mos lus la snam bu ltar dkre zhing khro chu khol ma'i nang du keng rus la thug gi bar 'tshod par byed/

mnar med ni/ yang bros pas phyogs bzhi nas me'i shugs 'ong nas 'tshig ste/ sha rgyus rus pa rnams bshig nas mar me'i snying po bzhin du lus thams cad me lce 'bar bas khyab cing*/ smre sngags 'don pas sems can du 'du shes pa tsam dang*/ gzhan yang lcags kyi thu lum 'bar ba khar 'jug pa sogs kyis sdug bsngal dpag med myong ba rnams yang dang yang du bsams pa'i tshul gyis snying thag pa nas 'jigs zhum zhum pa zhig 'ong bar bya/ de lta bu'i sdug bsngal de yang rgyun thung ngu tsam ma yin par/ mi'i lo lnga bcu la rgyal chen rigs bzhi pa'i nyin zhag gcig /de sum cu la zla ba/ de bcu gnyis la lor byas pa'i lo lnga brgya ni rgyal chen bzhi pa'i tshe tshad dang*/ de thams cad bsdoms pa la zhag gcig /de sum cu la zla ba/ de bcu gnyis la lor byas pa'i rang lo lnga brgya ni/ yang sos pa'i tshe tshad yin zhing*/ de bzhin du mi lo brgya/ nyis brgya/ bzhi brgya/ brgyad brgya/ stong drug brgya la zhag gcig tu byas nas lo stong*/ nyis stong*/ bzhi stong*/ brgyad stong*/ khri drug stong ni rim pa bzhin sum cu rtsa gsum pa nas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa'i bar gyi tshe tshad yin la/ lha'i tshe de dag rim pa bzhin du thig nag nas tsha ba'i bar gyi zhag gcig rer byas nas lo stong nas khri drug stong gi bar thub/ rab tu tsha ba bar bskal byed dang mnar med ni bar gyi bskal ba gcig gi bar du sdug bsngal myong ba'i tshul bsam zhing*/ dmyal ba brgyad kyi nang gi tshe thung shos yang sos pa'i tshe tshad ni lo khrag khrig gcig ther 'bum chen po drug ther 'bum gnyis te/ lhag ma rnams brgyad 'gyur gyis ring bas/ da lta me stag lta bus tsha ba'i sdug bsngal rgyun thung du byung ba tsam yang mi bzod na/ sngar ltar sdug bsngal shin du che zhing rgyun ring ba de ji ltar bzod snyam du bsam/ de nas dmyal ba brgyad po de dag re re la yang rtsig ngos bzhi bzhi dang sgo bzhi yod la/

de dag gi phyi rol tu lcags kyi ra bas bskor zhing de la yang sgo bzhi bzhi yod pa'i sgo re re na/ me ma mur gyi 'obs sogs 'khor gyi dmyal ba bzhi bzhi yod pa las/ sgo'i thad sor me ma mur gyi 'obs dang de nas rim pa bzhin du ro myags kyi 'dam dang*/ spu gri'i lam sogs dang*/ chu klung rab med rnams na sdug bsngal gyi khyad par dpag med myong ba'i tshul bsam/ gnyis pa grang dmyal ni/ grang dmyal brgyad ka'i gnas kyi 'og kha ba'i thang dang 'khyag rom/ mtha' gangs ri'i phreng ba/ nang mun pas khyab cing kha ba rlung dang 'thab pa'i bu yug 'tshub par 'dra bas de'i nang du rang nyid skyes yang bsam/ dang po chu bur can ni/ lus la kha ba'i bu yug chen po rlung gi phyogs kun nas btab pas chu bur 'byung zhing 'khums pa'i sdug bsngal myong bar bsam/ chu bur rdol ba ni/ de las kyang grang nas chu bur rdol te rnag khrag sogs 'dzag /a chu zer ba ni/ de las grang nas skad gdangs drag pos de ltar du 'don/ kyi hud zer ba ni/ de bas kyang grang nas skad kyi phugs nas gdengs de skad 'don/ so tham tham pa ni/ sngar las kyang grang nas skad 'don mi nus par so tham tham phyed/ la ltar gas pa ni/ de las kyang grang nas lus kyi mdog sngon por gyur te kha lnga'am drug cu gas/ pad+ma ltar gas pa ni/ de bas kyang grang nas sha'u dmar hu re bar gyur nas tshal pa bcu sogs su gas/ pad+ma chen po ltar gas pa ni/ de las kyang shin du grang nas lus kyi mdog dmar por gyur te kha brgya'am de las mang du gas pa'i sdug bsngal dpag med myong bar bsam/ yun tshad ni/ til gyi sbyar ma gnyis bre bo che'i khal brgyad cu ba zhig til gyis byur bur bkang ste/ lo brgya brgya nas til re re byung bas til de ma lus par zad pa'i yun ni/ chu bur can gyi tshe tshad dang*/ gzhan rnams snga ma las phyi ma nyi shu nyi shus ring bar gsungs pas/

da lta dgun gyi lhag pa shin du grang ba'i nang du gcer bur ring du gnas pa lta ci/ cung zad gnas na'ang grang ba'i sdug bsngal bzod dka' na/ sngar gyi sdug bsngal ches yun ring ba de ji ltar bzod snyam du rang rgyud la bkar nas bsam/ gzhan yang dmyal ba gnyis kyi 'khor dang mi'i yul dang mtsho 'gram sogs na nye tshe ba'i dmyal ba thag pa dar gtun dang phyag ma dang ka ba dang rtsig pa dang phru chen la sogs pa'i dbyibs can yod par bshad pa rnams kyi sdug bsngal yang bsam mo/ /gnyis pa dud 'gro ni/ dbyings na gnas pa ni chu mtshams man chad kyi khongs su 'bru'i phung bau ltar spungs nas yod cing*/ che bas chung ba dag za zhing chung bas che ba'i lus 'big pa dang*/ mun nag 'thib por rang gi rkang lag brkyang bskum tsam yang mi mthong zhing gcig gis gcig mnan pa'i sdug bsngal dang*/ klu'i rigs la bye tshan dang nam mkha' lding gi 'jigs pa dang*/ bya dang ri dwags sogs su skyes na rngon pa sogs kyis gtses pa dang*/ rta glang bong bu sogs la bkol spyad brdeg pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal yod tshul rnams bsam/ mdor na da ltar nga la gzhan gyis brdeg pa'i sdug bsngal cung zad kyang myong mi 'dod na/ phyi mar bong bu lta bur gyur nas gzhan zhig gis khur ba kal bzhin par rdeg 'tshog yang yang byed na de'i sdug bsngal ji ltar bzod snyam du bsam par bya'o/ /gsum pa yi dwags ni/ 'dod pa'i dngos po mtha' dag gis dben zhing shin du nyam nga ba'i gnas su skyes par mos te/ de la phyi'i sgrib pa can ni bza' btung gi rigs mi rnyed cing*/ gal te chu klung dang ljon shing 'bras bu can sogs mthong nas rtsar phyin pa na mtshon cha thogs pa'i srung mas 'gegs pa'am/ yang na rnag khrag sogs su mthong ba dang*/ nang gi sgrib pa can ni kha khab mig tsam mgrin pa rta rnga tsam lto ba yul ljongs tsam yan lag 'jag ma tsam du gyur nas/ zas skom mi rnyed cing rnyed kyang khar mi shong la shong yang mgrin par mi thar thar kyang lto ba mi khengs/

zas skom gyi sgrib pa can ni zos shing 'thungs pa rnams mer 'bar nas khong pa 'tshig cing*/ mi gtsang ba dang rang gi sha yang bcad kyin za ba dang*/ dbyar zla zer yang tsha la dgun nyi zer yang grang ba'i sdug bsngal myong tshul rnams bsam/ mdor na da lta rang zas skom med par nyin zhag gcig kyang 'dug dka' na yi dwags zhig tu skyes nas zas skom mi rnyed pa'i bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal rgyun ring du myong bar 'gyur ba ji ltar bzod snyam du yang yang bsam/ de'i phyir de dag las thar pa'i thabs da lta nyid nas bsgrub par bya'o snyam du bsam/ gnyis pa phyi mar bde ba'i thabs la gnyis/ bstan pa'i 'jug sgo skyabs 'gro sbyang ba dang*/ bde legs kyi rtsa ba las 'bras la yid ches kyi dad pa bskyed pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ bslab bya'o/ /dang po ni/ gong du brjod pa'i ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal de rnams las skyob pa'i skyabs yang dag zhig 'tshol dgos par 'dug pas/ de ni ji skad du/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyi skyabs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de sku mtshan dpes spras shing mthong na mi mthun pa med pa/ gsung yan lag drug cu rtsa bzhi dang ldan zhing sems can thams cad kyi skad dang mthun pa'i dri ba'i lan 'debs nus pa/ thugs shes bya mtha' dag mngon sum du gzigs shing sems can thams cad la thugs rjes rgyun chad med par gzigs pa/ 'phrin las 'gro ba'i don la 'bad med lhun grub tu 'jug pa'i sgo nas rgyun mi chad du phan 'dogs pa/ rang 'jigs pa mtha' dag las grol zhing gzhan sgrol ba la mkhas pa sogs kyi yon tan dang ldan pas skyabs ston pa por 'os/ de lta bu'i sangs rgyas de spangs rtogs kyi chos snga ma mngon du mdzad pa las byung bas lung gi brjod byar gyur pa'i spangs rtogs kyis bsdus pa'i rtogs pa'i chos dkon mchog rnams skyabs dngos su 'os/

chos dkon mchog de yang slob pa 'phags pa rnams kyis tshul bzhin du bsgrub par mdzad pa la rag las pas 'phags pa de rnams skyabs bsgrub pa'i zla grogs su 'os pa'i tshul rnams bsams te/ de dag gi yon tan dran pa'i sgo nas dad pa shugs can bya zhing dpung gnyen zhu 'dod kyi blo dung dung ba zhig bskyed pas/ de'i mthus ji skad du/ gang zhig mos pa gtsor byed pa/ /de'i mdun na thub pa bzhugs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skyabs yul de rnams thugs rjes dbang gis mdun gyi nam mkhar mngon sum du byon byung snyam du bsams la/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa las sgrol ba'i ston pa mdzad du gsol/ 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /ma dag 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa las sgrol ba'i skyabs dngos mdzad du gsol/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa las sgrol ba'i zla grogs mdzad du gsol/ zhes nyer gcig gam bdun sogs brjod cing 'od zer 'phro sbyang bya/ gnyis pa bslab bya ni/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas 'jig rten pa'i lha la skyabs su mi 'gro zhing de'i sku brnyan rnams la'ang sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes/ chos la skyabs su song nas sems can la gnod 'tshe spong zhing tshig bzhi ba yan la'ang chos dkon mchog gi 'du shes/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas mu stegs can nam sdig grogs dang 'dris mi che zhing rab byung gi rtags can tsam la'ang dge 'dun dngos kyi 'du shes 'jog pa dang*/ ci za ci 'thung gi phud kyis mchod par bya'o/ /skyabs su song ba'i phan yon ni/ nang ba sangs rgyas par tshud pa dang*/ las sgrib 'dags pa/ tshogs rdzogs par 'gyur ba sogs mang ngo*/ /gnyis pa rtsa ba yid ches kyi dad pa sbyang ba ni/ dkon mchog la skyabs su song yang las dkar nag la blang dor phyin ci log tu spyad na dkon mchog gis kyang skyob mi nus pas/

las dkar nag la 'dor len tshul bzhin du bya dgos la/ dge mi dge'i las la nang gses kyis phye na rnam grangs mang yang*/ rags pa rnams bsdus na dkar nag gi las lam bcu tshan gnyis su 'du bas/ 'di la gsum/ nag po'i las 'bras/ dkar po'i las 'bras/ de dag la 'jug ldog ji ltar bya'o/ /dang po la bcu las/ srog gcod ni/ gzhi rang las gzhan pa'i sems can bsam pa'i khyad par der 'du shes shing nyon mongs dug gsum gang rung gi sgo nas kun slong gsod par 'dod de sbyor ba rang ngam gzhan la byed du bcug pas mtshon dug sogs ci rigs byas pa'i rkyen gyis mthar thug rang gi sngon du shi ba na srog gcod kyi mi dge ba'i las kyi dngos gzhi rdzogs/ ma byin len ni/ gzhi rang mi dbang zhing gzhan gyis bdag tu bzung ba'i gser sogs la der 'du shes shing nyon mongs gang rung gi sgo nas kun slong 'bral bar 'dod de sbyor ba thabs sna tshogs kyis blangs te mthar thug thob blo skyes pa na rdzogs/ log g.yem ni/ gzhi gzhan gyis bdag tu bzung ba'am rang gi nye du sogs bgrod bya min pa dang bgrod bya yin kyang kha dang bshang lam sogs yan lag min pa dang*/ rten gyi drung sogs gnas min pa dang bsnyen gnas pa sogs dus ma yin pa gang rung la der 'du shes shing*/ nyon mongs gang rung gi sgo nas kun slong bgrod par 'dod de sbyor ba de'i don la brtson pas mthar thug gnyis kyi gnyis sprad pa sogs las rdzogs/ rdzun du smra ba ni/ gzhi mngon shes sogs med pa lta bu la der 'du shes shing nyon mongs gang rung gi sgo nas kun slong 'du shes bsgyur nas smra bar 'dod de sbyor ba lus ngag gang rung gi rnam 'gyur bstan pas mthar thug pha rol bos don go ba na rdzogs/ phra ma ni/ gzhi gang zag gnyis lta bu la der 'du shes shing nyon mongs gang rung gi sgo nas kun slong dbye bar 'dod de sbyor ba 'byed nus kyi tshig smras pa mthar thug don go ba na rdzogs/

tshig rtsub ni/ gzhi mnar sems skye ba'i gzhir gyur pa'i sems can la der 'du shes shing nyon mongs gang rung gi sgo nas kun slong ngag rtsub po smra bar 'dod de sbyor ba pha rol bo'i skyon brjod pas mthar thug don go ba na rdzogs/ ngag kyal ni/ gzhi don med pa dang ldan pa la der 'du shes shing nyon mongs gang rung gi sgo nas kun slong byung rgyal du smra bar 'dod de sbyor ba ngag kyal smra bar rtsom pas mthar thug smras zin pa na rdzogs/ brnab sems ni/ gzhi gzhan gyi nor dang longs spyod la der 'du shes shing rang nor la chags sems dang gsog sems/ gzhan nor la ro myang sems dang 'khu sems ngo tsha dang nyes dmigs thil gyis non pa'i chos lnga nyon mongs gang rung gi sgo nas kun slong bdag gir bya bar 'dod de sbyor ba rang la 'byung ba'i ched du yid kyis rtsol bas mthar thug der smon cing thag bcad pa na rdzogs/ gnod sems ni/ gzhi yid du mi 'ong ba'i sems can la der 'du shes shing gnod byed kyi rgyu la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i zhe sdang*/ gnod byed la mi bzod pa/ tshul min yid phyed dran pa'i 'khan 'dzin/ brdeg pa sogs byas na snyam pa'i 'khu sems/ ngo tsha dang nyes dmigs zil gyis non pa'i chos lnga ldan gyi nyon mongs gang rung gi sgo nas kun slong brdeg gsod sogs bya bar 'dod de sbyor ba de byed par rtsol zhing mthar thug dngos su nus na byed par thag bcad pa na rdzogs/ log lta ni/ gzhi dkon mchog dang las 'bras lta bu yod pa'i don la med par 'du shes shing nyon mongs dug gsum gang rung gi sgo nas kun slong skur ba 'debs par 'dod de sbyor ba bsams pa ltar med par thag bcad pa na log lta'i dngos gzhi rdzogs par 'gyur tshul rnams gsum/ de dag nang gser kyi lci yang ni/ lus ngag gi bdun snga ma snga ma lci la yid kyi gsum phyi ma phyi ma lci/ spyir bla ma dkon mchog pha ma sogs la phan gnod gang byas kyang zhing gi sgo nas stobs che/

bsam pa shugs drag cing rgyun ring por byas pa dang*/ shes bzhin gyi khyad gsod dang sems can mang po'i don du byas pa sogs bsam pa'i sgo na stobs che/ mchod sbyin rnam dag dang sgrub pa'i mchod pa sogs dngos po'i sgo nas stobs che/ spyir sdom pa dang ldan mi ldan gnyis las ldan pas byas pa ni rten gyi sgo nas stobs che ba'i tshul sogs kyang shes par bya/ de dag gi 'bras bu ji lta bu yin pa ni/ sa bon sna tshogs btab kyang 'bras bu mi 'tshol ba ltar/ sdig pa shin tu lci bas rnam smin gyi 'bras bu dmyal ba/ 'bring gis yi dwags/ chung ngus dud 'gror skye/ rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu srog gcod kyis tshe thung*/ ma byin len gyis longs spyod dbul/ log g.yem gyis chung ma bsrung du mi btub/ rdzun gyis mi kha sdang*/ phra mas mdza' bshes nyung*/ tshig rtsub kyis mi snyan pa thos/ ngag khyal gyis tshig mi btsan/ brnab sems kyis re ba mi 'grub/ gnod sems kyis 'jigs skrag che/ log ltas yang dag pa'i don la rmongs/ bdag po'i 'bras bu yang rim par sbyar te/ gang du skyes pa der bza' btung rang sman gyi nus pa nyams/ lo 'bras nyung zhing smin mi nus/ 'dam rdzab mang*/ 'jigs skrag che/ sa phyogs mi snyoms shing bgrod dka' sdong dum dang tsher ma dang rdo sogs mang*/ ljon shing la 'bras bu mi chags/ phun tshogs 'grib/ dgra gdon gyis 'tshe/ bzang ngan go ldog par 'gyur ba la sogs bsam/ gnyis pa dkar bo'i las lam ni/ gong du bshad pa ltar mi dge ba bcu go ldog pa ni dge ba bcu yin la/ dge ba'i las chung 'bring chen po gsum gyis rnam smin gyi 'bras bu rim pa bzhin du ma 'dod lha gong ma'i lhar skye/ rgyu mthun ni tshe ring ba sogs dang*/ bdag 'bras ni sman mthu che ba sogs sngar las ldog ste sbyar ba 'byung ba'i tshul bsam/ sbyin pa lta bu gzhi nas mthar thug gi bar dge sems kho nas zin pa ni gcig tu dkar ba'i las dang*/

srog gcod lta bu de dag sdig sems kho nas zin pa ni gcig tu nag pa'i las yin la/ de bzhin du bsam pa'i dbang gis las nag la rnam smin dkar ba dang las dkar la rnam smin nag pa ni 'dres ma'i las/ 'phen byed dge bas 'phangs la rdzogs byed mi dge bas rdzogs pa dang mi dge bas 'phangs shing dge bas rdzogs pa/ myong bar nges pa myong bar ma nges pa tshe 'di la myong ba phyi mar myong ba'i las kyi khyad par rnams bsams nas blang dor byed 'dod bskyed cing dpyad sgom bya/ khyad par rnam mkhyen sgrub pa'i rten du sa chod che bas/ tshe kha dog rigs dbang phyug tshig btsan pa dbang che ba skyes pa yin pa stobs dang ldan pa ste rnam smin gyi yon tan brgyad ldan gyi lus rten thob pa'i thabs su/ gzhan gyi srog skyob pa/ rten la mar me 'bul ba la sogs rgyu brgyad bsgrub pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /gsum pa 'jug ldog ji ltar bya ba ni/ de ltar las 'bras kyi rnam gzhag shes nas rgyal bas gsungs pa la yid ches pa'i sgo nas dge sdig la blang dor legs par bya/ de ltar byas kyang bag med pa dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis nyes pa byung ba la 'jigs pas yid blong blong bor gyur pa na/ dkon mchog gi rten gyi drung du skyabs 'gro dang byang chub kyi sems sgom pa rten gyi stobs/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod pa sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ phyin chad mi byed pa slar ldog pa'i stobs/ phyag 'tshal zhing phung po gsum pa 'don pa sogs gnyen po kun du spyod pa'i stobs rnams nyams su len pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'bring dang thun mong ba'i lam la blo sbyong ba ni/ lam sgron las/ srid pa'i bde la rgyab phyogs shing*/ /sdig pa'i las las ldog bdag nyid/ /gang zhig rang zhi tsam don gnyer/ /skyes bu de ni 'bring zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nyams su len pa la/ gong du brjod pa ltar nyams su blangs pas ngan 'gro las thar ba zhig byung kyang de tsam gyis mi chog gi

/las nyon gyi dbang gis 'khor ba'i gnas su nying 'tshams sbyor ba'i bcings pa las grol ba'i thar ba thob par bya dgos pas 'di la gnyis/ thar ba don gnyer gyi blo bskyed pa dang*/ der bgrod pa'i lam gyi rang bzhin bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ sdug kun gnyis kyi sgo nas bsam pa dang*/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas bsam pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang*/ kun 'byung 'khor ba'i 'jug rim mo/ /dang po la gsum/ ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsams pa gong du song bas na mi dang bde 'gro gzhan gnyis/ rigs drug thun mong ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa'o/ /dang po ni/ las nyon gyi dbang gis skye ba blangs pa 'di skye rga na 'chi sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa'i gnas su gyur ba ste/ de yang skye ba'i sdug bsngal ni mngal skyes la mtshon na/ ma'i mngal du nying mtshams sbyar nas btsal ba la thug gi bar mas bza' btung ha cang tsha ba dang grang ba bsten pa'i rkyen gyis tsha grang gi sdug bsngal dang*/ 'chong ba dang brgyugs pa sogs kyi tshe sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong bzhin pa'i ngang nas zhag phyed dang sum brgya lhag tsam song ba na/ las kyi rlung gis mgo bo thur du bstan nas phyir btsa' ba'i tshe mngal sgor btsir ba dang*/ btsas nas stan la bzhag pa dang gzhan gyis lag tu blangs pa sogs kyi tshe tsha zhing rtsub pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba'i tshul bsam/ rga ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ na tshod dar ba'i skabs kyi mdangs stobs nyams nas lus rgud skra dkar so thon 'gro 'dug dka' mig mi gsal ba sogs 'chi ba la phyogs pa'i sdug bsngal/ na ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ tshor ba sdug bsngal gyis lus sems gdungs shing zas skom spyad du mi btub pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal/ 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ sman pa sogs kyis bor te bkrag mdangs nyams/ kha skams/ mchu brdzes/ sna zhoms/ mi gdong mor song*/ gnyen bshes rnams kyis bskor nas smre sngags 'don bzhin du 'khor longs spyod phun tshogs rnams dang lus 'di nyid kyang mal du bzhag nas mi 'dod bzhin du 'chi dgos pa'i sdug bsngal/

mi sdug pa dang 'phrad pa ni/ dgra dang 'phrad pa'am gtam ngan gyis 'jigs pa sogs las sdug bsngal/ sdug pa dang bral ba ni 'phangs shing sdug pa'i gnyen sogs dang bral ba las sdug bsngal/ 'dod pa btsal te ma rnyed pa ni/ rang gi 'dod don bsgrubs kyang ma grub pas sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i tshul rnams snying thag pa nas bsam mo/ /gnyis pa bde 'gro gzhan gnyis kyi sdug bsngal ni/ lha min rnams lha'i dpal 'byor la mi bzod pa'i phrag dog la brten nas 'thab cing rtsod pa'i sdug bsngal dang bcas/ lha'i nang tshan 'dod lha rnams 'chi bar nye ba'i tshe/ lus kyi bkrag mdangs nyams pa sogs 'chi ltas lnga dang lus kyi 'od chung ba sogs nye ba'i 'chi ltas lnga byung bar rig nas sdug bsngal ba sogs dang bcas/ gong sa'i lha rnams sdug bsngal rags pa med kyang gnas pa dang 'chi 'pho ba rang dbang ma thob pa'i gnas ngan len gyi sdug bsngal dang bcas pa'i tshul rnams bsam/ gsum pa rigs drug thun mong ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ 'khor ba las mthar phyin tshangs par gyur kyang slar bran du 'gyur ba lta bu ni 'grub pa'i sdug bsngal/ skye rga na 'chi bzhi ni grub pa'i sdug bsngal/ rma 'bras tsha ba'i sdug bsngal cher song ba lta bu sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal/ phyin nas ngal ba na bsdad pas bde bar snang yang bsdad drag na slar na ba lta bu 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ 'khyags pa'i sbubs su chud pa zhig de las ma thar bar du 'gro ba'i skabs med pa lta bu ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin la/ mdor na nyer len gyi phung po 'di blangs phyin da lta dang ma 'ongs pa'i sdug bsngal 'dren pa las 'os med snyam du bsam/ nyer len gyi phung bo zhes pa ni rgyu 'bras gnyis kyi sgo nas btags pa yin la/ de yang nyer len ni 'dun pa dang 'dod chags la zer zhing*/ ma 'ongs pa'i phung bo thob 'dod kyi 'dun pa dang da lta'i phung bo la chags pa'i 'dod chags kyi dbang gis phung bo phyi ma 'grub pas rgyu'i sgo nas dang*/

da lta'i phung bo la brten nas kyang phung bo thob 'dod kyi 'dun pa dang 'dod chags 'dren pas 'bras bu'i sgo nas btags pa ste/ de ltar gcig las gcig 'byung ba'i tshul gyis 'khor bar 'khor ba'i tshul bsam/ gzhan yang 'khor ba na pha bu dang bu phar 'gyur zhing dbang che ba chung ba dang chung ba'ang che bar 'gyur la/ dgra gnyen go bzlog ste 'gyur ba sogs nges pa med pas 'khor ba la yid gtan mi 'dug snyam du myong ba ma thon gyi bar du bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa kun 'byung 'khor ba'i 'jug rim ni/ de ltar 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal shes par byas nas de mi 'dod na/ de'i rgyu ngos bzung nas spong dgos pas rgyu gang yin na/ 'di la las nyon gnyis yod kyang nyon mongs gtso bo yin la/ de ni sems rgyud ma zhi bar byed pa'i shes pa zhig gi steng nas 'jog cing rnam grangs mang yang gtso bo'i dbang du byas na lta ba lnga dang lta min lngar 'du bas de dag rang rgyud kyi steng du ngos bzung na/ 'dod chags ni rang nyid gang la chags pa skye ba'i yul de la rjes su chags pas lta ba dang reg pa sogs longs spyod 'dod kyi blo dung dung yod pa'i nyon mongs/ khong khro ni/ dgra lta bu zhig la dmigs nas mnar sems rtsub pos zhe sdang sol me rlung gis sbar ba lta bu lam lam skye ba'i nyon mongs/ nga rgyal ni/ 'jig lta'i dbang gis rigs nor yon tan longs spyod sogs la brten nas gang zag 'dis bdag gi ba spu'i cha tsam yang mi bdo snyam du rang nyid la mchog tu 'dzin pa khengs pa'i rnam pa can gyi nyon mongs/ ma rig pa ni/ las 'bras dang chos kyi gnas lugs bsgrib cing mi gsal bar byed pa'i nyon mongs/ the tshom nyon mongs can ni/ dkon mchog dang las 'bras sogs yod dam med bden nam mi bden snyam nas don mi 'gyur du dogs pa'i nyon mongs/ 'jig lta ni/ nyer len gyi phung po'i steng nas nga dang nga'i zhes rang dbang ba'i bdag tu 'dzin pa'i shes rab nyon mongs can/

mthar lta ni/ 'jig ltas bzung ba'i bdag de rtag pa ther zug tu lta ba'am 'di nas phyi mar nying 'tshams sbyor ba med par lta ba'i shes rab nyon mongs can/ lta ba mchog 'dzin ni/ 'jig lta sogs lta ngan gsum gang rung dang de dag las byung ba'i phung bo la dmigs nas mchog tu 'dzin pa'i shes rab nyon mongs can/ tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin gyi lta ba ni/ rang gi blo ngor tshul 'chal spangs pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ tshul dang cha byad dang lus ngag gi 'jug pa nges pa'i brtul zhugs dang*/ de dag las byung ba'i phung bo la dmigs nas grol bar 'dod pa'i shes rab nyon mongs can/ log lta ni las 'bras sogs med par lta ba'am snod bcud rnams dbang phyug sogs kyis byas par 'dzin pa'i shes rab nyon mongs can no/ /de dag ngo shes par byas nas nam rang rgyud la skyes pa na dang du mi len cing spong bar bya ste/ nyon mongs de dag gis las bsags nas de'i dbang gis 'khor ba dang ngan song du skye bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /nyon mongs pas bskyed pa'i las la sems pa'i las dang*/ bsam pa'i las gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems yul la g.yo zhing bskul bar byed pa'i sems byung yin la/ gnyis pa ni/ sems pa ni sems pa des kun nas slangs pa'i lus ngag gi rig byed dang mnyam du 'jug pa'i sems pa yin zhing*/ 'phen byed kyi las gsog pa po so skye rnams yin la/ las de la bsod nams dang bsod nams ma yin pa dang mi g.yo ba'i las gsum/ dang po ni/ 'dod khams kyi sbyin pa gtong ba sogs dge ba'i las/ gnyis pa ni/ srog gcod pa sogs mi dge ba'i las/ gsum pa ni khams gong ma'i sas bsdus pa'i zhi gnas sogs bsgoms pa'i las so/ /smin tshul ni/ mngon pa las/ las kyis 'khor bar lci gar dang*/ /nye ba gang dang goms pa gang*/ /sngon byas gang yin de dag las/ /snga ma snga ma rnam smin 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis 'byung*/

las kyi dbang gis 'chi ba dang nying 'tshams sbyor tshul ni/ rkyen gang rung gis 'chi ba na phyi dbugs chad ka'i tshe/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gyi sems gsum ci rigs 'byung la/ 'di'i skabs su sdig sems ma skyes pa gal che/ phyi dbugs chad nas nang dbugs ma chad pa'i bar der 'chi sems phra mor 'gyur bas lung ma bstan gyi sems kho na 'byung*/ spyir btang dge ba byed pa rnams gnad gcod chung zhing gzugs yid du 'ong ba rmi lam bzhin du mthong la/ mi dge ba byed pa rnams de las ldog ste 'byung yang dmigs bsal ma nges/ snying kha nas rnam shes 'phos pa dang mnyam du srang mda'i mtho dman ltar bar dor 'gro ba gang du skye 'gyur gyi byad dbyibs can gyi bar do 'grub po/ der zhag zhe dgu tshun chad bdun phrag ci rigs par gnas nas/ gang gi tshe skye gnas sgyu ma bzhin du mthong ste der chags sdang gi dbang gis nying 'tshams sbyor ba'i tshul rnams bsam/ gnyis pa sdug kun gnyis kyi sgo nas bsams pas myong ba thon na rten 'brel gyi sgo nas bsam dgos pa'i nges pa med kyang*/ 'ga' zhig la 'char bde bas de'i dbang du byas te cung zad brjod pa la/ ma rig pa la las 'bras la rmongs pa yod na'ang gtso bor yan lag dang po de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa'i dbang gis 'du byed kyi las dkar nag gang rung zhig bsags te las de'i bag chags rgyu dus kyi rnam shes kyi steng du bsgos pa la 'dod sred sogs kyi sred pa dang der chags pa'i len pa gnyis kyis gsos btab pas/ srid pa'i rten 'brel mthu can du song nas/ rgyu dus kyi rnam shes de nyid phyi mar 'gro ba gnyis gang rung zhig tu nying 'tshams sbyar ba'i tshe 'bras dus kyi rnam shes kyi rten 'brel grub pa dang mnyam du tshor ba sogs ming dang mer mer bo sogs gzugs kyi rten 'brel dang skye ba yang grub/ de 'phel bas mig la sogs pa skye mched kyi rten 'brel/

de nas yul dbang rnam shes gsum 'dus te reg pa'i rten 'brel/ de las tshor ba'i rten 'brel/ phung bo na tshod gzhan du 'gyur ba'i cha ni rga ba dang phung bo'i rigs mthun dor ba ni shi ba'i rten 'brel lo/ /de ni tshe gnyis la rdzogs pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ tshe gsum la rdzogs pa'ang yod do/ /bsdu na 'phen byed kyi rgyu 'bras gnyis dang*/ 'grub byed kyi rgyu 'bras gnyis su 'du ste/ ma rig pa 'du byed rgyu dus kyi rnam shes gsum ni 'phen byed kyi rgyu dang rnam shes kyi phyed 'bras dus kyi rnam shes nas tshor ba'i bar lnga 'phangs pa'i 'bras bu yin la/ sred len srid las gsum 'grub byed kyi rgyu dang skye ba dang rga shi gnyis 'grub pa'i 'bras bur 'du ba'i phyir ro/ /de yang gang gis 'phen na ma rig pa la brten pa'i 'du byed kyi las dkar nag gang rung gis 'phen cing ji ltar 'phangs na rgyu dus kyi rnam shes la las de'i bag chags bsgos pa'i tshul gyis 'phangs/ gang gis 'grub na sred pa'i rkyen dang ldan pa'i len pas 'grub la des gang grub pa ni skye rga gnyis so/ /de lta bu'i tshul gyis 'khor ba'i gnas su mgal me'i 'khor lo bzhin du yang yang 'khor ba'i tshul bsams nas yid skyo shas drag pos de las thar 'dod kyi blo shugs drag bskyed cing gong 'phel du gtang bar bya la/ de yang ngan 'gro'i rten 'brel bsams te skyes bu chung ngu dang thun mong ba dang*/ bde 'gro'i rten 'brel bsams nas 'bring dang thun mong ba'i lam la blo sbyang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa thar bar bgrod pa'i lam gyi rang bzhin ni/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mthong nas de las nges par 'byung 'dod skyes pa des/ lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum la 'bad dgos pas/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa ni/ so thar sogs rang gis gang khas blangs pa rnams dang*/ rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba'i gtso bo mi dge bcu spong gi tshul khrims bsrung ba la 'bad cing*/

ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa dang shes rab kyi bslab pa'i gtso bo ni zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gis bsdus pas 'og nas 'chad pa ltar bslab par bya dgos te/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pas nyon mongs pa mngon gyur rnams sun 'byin/ ting nge 'dzin gyis mgo mnon/ shes rab kyis nyon mongs pa'i sa bon spangs nas rnam par grol bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /tshul khrims bsrung ba la rang ngos nas ci nus su 'bad kyang bag med sogs kyis nyes ltung byung na ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo bzhi bo shes nas bsrung*/ da dung yang nyes pa 'byung na kye ma 'di ni rang gis rang la nges par gnod par byas pa ste/ las 'bras mi bslu bas 'di ltar byas na phyi mar ngan 'gror ltung bar 'gyur du 'ong snyam du bsams nas stobs bzhi bshags sdom la rgyun du 'bad par bya ste/ las nyon gnyis las nyon mongs gtso yang las dang po bas lhag par las sgrib sbyong ba gnad che bar rje nyid kyis bshad pas so/ /gsum pa skyes bu chen po'i lam gyi rim pa la blo sbyong ba ni/ de ltar 'khor ba las grol ba'i ched du bslab pa gsum la 'bad nas 'khor ba las grol bar byed pa ni mchog yin kyang*/ 'dir de tsam gyis mi chog par/ ji skad du lam sgron las/ rang rgyud rtog pa'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /gang zhig gzhan gyi sdug bsngal kun/ /yang dag zad par kun nas 'dod/ /skyes bu de ni mchog yin no/ /zhes gsung pa ltar sems can thams cad kyi don bsgrub dgos pas/ de la ni theg chen gyi lam du 'jug dgos so/ /'di la gnyis/ spyod pa'i rten sems bskyed pa dang*/ spyod pa la slob tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ theg chen la 'jug pa'i sgo gang yin snyam na/ de ni byang chub kyi sems yin te/ 'di rgyud la skyes tsam nas theg chen par chud cing ma skyes pa'am nyams na yon tan gzhan ji lta bu yod kyang der mi chud pa'i phyir na sangs rgyas kyi rgyu thun mong ma yin pa'i sa bon lta bu yin pas so/

/'di sbyong ba'i man ngag la gnyis/ jo bo chen po dang*/ rgyal sras zhi ba lha nas brgyud pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyi sgo nas sbyong tshul te/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas ni byang chub kyi sems las 'byung*/ de lhag bsam rnam dag las/ de snying rje chen po las/ de byams pa las/ de drin gzo ba las/ de drin dran pa las/ de mar shes pa las 'byung bas so/ /des na 'di la gnyis/ gzhan don don gnyer dang*/ byang chub don gnyer bskyed tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis/ de'i gzhi bsgrub pa dang*/ de bskyed tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ sngar ltar skyes bu chung 'bring gi skabs ji ltar 'tsham pa sngon du song nas sems can thams cad mar shes pa sogs kyi sngon du btang snyoms bsgom pa gnad che bas/ dgra gnyen bar ma'i sems can zhig mdun du gsal btab ste/ rtog pa gang skye bltas pas chags pa skye na 'dis sngon bdag gi dgra mang du byas nas gnod pa yod pas na ci'i phyir chags/ sdang ba skye na 'dis sngon bdag gi gnyen byas nas phan btags pa'ang srid pas sdang du ga la rung snyam ste chags sdang gi rtog pa bkag nas sems snyoms par bsgrub/ de nas pha ma dang gnyen gzhan dang dgra sogs la sbyar nas bsgom/ mdor na dgra gnyen go ldog ste gyur ba dang 'gyur ba'ang mang bas na/ bdag gis 'dir gang la ni chags shing su la sdang bar bya snyam nas btang snyoms bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas mar shes pa sogs gsum las/ dang po ni/ rang gi ma gsal btab ste/ ma 'dis 'khor ba thogs ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du bdag gi ma yang yang byas shing da dung byed par 'gyur snyam du bsam/ de nas pha dang gnyen gzhan dang*/ bar ma dang*/ dgra sogs la'ang de ltar du sbyar nas sems can thams cad ma lta bur shes par bya/ gnyis pa ni/ ma 'dis bdag zla ba bcu'i bar du ltor bzung nas phan pa'i spyod lam thams cad bsten/ dal 'byor gyi lus srog 'di bskyed pas dang por drin che/

de nas btsas pa'i tshe 'jam pa'i stan la bzhag /brtse ba'i sems kyis bskyangs/ byams pa'i mig gis bltas/ dga' ba'i 'dzum gyis bsus/ snyan pa'i ming nas bos/ sha'i drod la bcar/ mngar ba'i nu zho bsnun/ zas lces snyod/ snabs khas phyis/ mi gtsang ba lag pas phyis/ 'jigs pa kun las skyabs pa sogs mdor na bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas phan dpag tu med pa btags pas drin shin du che'o snyam du bsam/ de nas pha sogs gzhan la kha sbos nas de ltar bsgoms pas drin dran par bya/ gsum pa ni/ de ltar shin tu drin che ba'i ma 'di rnams bde bas phongs shing 'khor ba dang ngan song gi gnas su sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gzir bas 'di rnams kyis bdag la mi re na su la re/ 'di rnams kyi don byed pa'i khur bdag la mi 'bab na su la 'bab/ des na bdag gis 'di rnams kyi don bya dgos na'ang zas skom nor rdzas sogs kyis phan btags kyang phan de tsam mi che bas/ nges par thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la 'god par bya'o snyam du snying thag pa nas bsam/ de nas pha sogs la rim gyis de ltar sbyar te drin gzo ba'i tshul bsam/ gnyis pa gzhan don don gnyer gyi blo bskyed tshul la gsum las/ dang po byams pa ni/ de bsgoms pa las phan yon dpag tu med pa 'byung ba'i tshul dran par byas nas/ ma gsal btab ste ma rgan 'di bde ba dang 'phrad na ci ma rung*/ bde ba dang 'phrad par gyur cig /ci nas kyang bde ba dang 'phrad par bdag gis bya'o snyam du bsam zhing ngag tu lan mang bor brjod cing*/ bde ba sna tshogs yid kyis sbyin par bya/ de nas pha sogs la rim gyis de ltar bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa snying rje ni/ phan yon dran par byas nas/ ma rgan 'di sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig /ci nas kyang sdug bsngal dang bral bar bya'o/ /snyam du bsam zhing lan mang du brjod cing sdug bsngal yid kyis blangs/

de nas pha sogs la de bzhin sbyor/ gsum pa lhag bsam ni/ bde bas phongs shing sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i ma rgan 'di bde ba dang ldan zhing sdug bsngal dang bral ba zhig nges par bdag gis bya'o/ /snyam du dam bca' zhing lan mang du brjod la/ pha sogs la'ang sbyar nas bsgom/ gnyis pa byang chub don gnyer gyi blo bskyed tshul ni/ de lta bu'i dam bca'i don bzhin sangs rgyas na ma gtogs da lta'i gnas skabs 'di lta bus bsgrub mi nus pas/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob 'dod kyi 'dun pa shugs drag pos skyabs 'gro'i skabs bzhin sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dran pa'i sgo nas bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob na ci ma rung*/ thob par gyur cig ci nas kyang thob par bya'o/ /snyam du bsam zhing ngag tu brjod par bya'o/ /gnyis pa zhi ba lha nas brgyud pa ni/ rang gces 'dzin la skyon du blta zhing gzhan gces 'dzin la yon tan du bltas pa'i sgo nas sbyong ba la de yang ma mdun du gsal btab ste/ snying thag pa nas rang gi sna bug gi rlung sangs kyis bus pa dang mnyam du rang rgyud kyi bde dge thams cad 'od zer dkar bo'i rnam pas rlung dang 'grogs te sna bug g.yas nas thon/ mdun gyi ma de'i sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs pas lus sems thams cad bde dges khyab song snam du byams pa bsgom pa dang*/ yang sna bug gi rlung rngub pa dang mnyam du de'i sdig sgrib sdug bsngal thams cad 'od zer nag bo'i rnam pas rlung la zhon nas drangs te ma'i sna bug g.yas nas thon/ rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs te snying khar nag phung nge byung bas de sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral song snyam du snying rje bsgom pa spel mar yang yang bya zhing*/ de nas pha sogs la'ang rim gyis de ltar sbyangs nas/ de rnams kyi ched du sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam du sems bskyed par bya'o/

/ma sogs la rim gyis bsgoms pa ni nges pa brtan po 'ong ba'i ched yin pas/ bsdus nas nyams su len pa'i tshe/ sems can thams cad la thun mong du dmigs pas de ltar bsam par byas na'ang legs/ gnyis pa spyod pa la slob tshul la gnyis/ phyin drug dang*/ bsdu bzhi la slob tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ sems bskyed kyang rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la ma bslab na 'tshang mi rgya zhing*/ spyir spyod pa'i dbye ba mtha' yas kyang byams mgon gyis spyod pa rnams bsdu na phyin drug tu 'du bar gsungs pa ltar 'du zhing grangs nges tshul la/ mngon mtho dang*/ don gnyis bsgrub pa dang*/ theg chen/ sdud pa dang*/ thabs kyi rnam pa dang*/ bslab gsum la bltos pa'i grangs nges sogs yod kyang*/ 'dir skabs don bsdus te brjod na drug las/ dang po ni/ gtong ba'i sems pa dge ba dang des kun nas bslangs pa'i lus ngag sbyin pa la 'jug bzhin pa'i dus kyi sems pa ni sbyin pa'i ngo bo yin la/ de rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i bsngo bas zin pa'i sgo nas goms pa yongs su rdzogs pa na sbyin pa'i phar phyin du 'gyur ro/ /dbye na chos/ mi 'jigs/ zang zing gi sbyin pa gsum/ ji ltar gtong tshul ni/ 'di la brten nas sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par bya'o snyam pa dgos pa la dmigs pa dang*/ dang po nas bdag gis btang zin pa yin pas bcol ba len pa dang mtshungs so snyam du dngos po la dmigs pa dang*/ len pa po 'di rnams bdag gi sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par byed pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen no snyam pa'i zhing la dmigs pa ste khyad par gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bzhin mdangs gsal ba sogs kyis sbyin par bya'o/ /chos kyi sbyin pa ni/ dngos su chos ston pa'am/ gleng mo'i tshul gyis blang dor bstan pa sogs bya/ mi 'jigs sbyin pa ni/ gzhan rgyal bo'am dgra dang me chu sogs kyi 'jigs pa las rang stobs kyis dngos su skyob pa dang de las thar pa'i thabs sogs bya/

zang zing gi sbyin pa ni/ bza' btung gos rin po che rta sogs ci rigs gtong bar brtson zhing*/ rang gis dngos su mi 'grub na'ang yid kyis rang gi lus longs spyod bde dge thams cad gang la gang 'tshams kyi rnam pas gtong ba'i blo goms par bya'o/ /de yang rang gi sna bug nas rlung phar 'gro ba na lus longs spyod sogs yid kyis gang dgos su sprul te btang bas de rnams kyi re ba rdzogs par gyur snyam du bsams pa ni/ shes rab can gyi sbyin par gsungs so/ /gal te gtong ba'i skabs min pa'am/ mi nus pa lta bu zhig yin na'ang dngos po de rnams dkon mchog la bsngos nas 'di ltar bsam par bya ste/ dngos po 'di rnams ni bdag gi dbang byar ga la 'gyur/ 'di dag sangs rgyas byang sems sogs kyi yin no snyam du rnam par brtags te bcangs na'ang thabs mkhas yin pas phan yon che bar bshad/ gnyis pa ni/ gzhan gnod gzhi bcas las yid phyir log pa'i spong sems ni tshul khrims kyi ngo bo yin la/ tshul khrims la nyes spyod sdom pa dge ba chos sdud/ sems can don byed gsum/ bsrung tshul la nyes spyod sdom pa ni/ rang gis khas blangs pa'i so thar dngos dang*/ mi dge bcu spong ba'i sdom pa rnams bsrung ba dang*/ de dag gi nyes pas gos ma gos rang rgyud la brtag par bya zhing*/ gal te nyes pas gos na phyir bcos dang stobs bzhi'i bshags bsdam la 'bad par bya'o/ /dge ba chos sdud ni/ byang sems kyi lus ngag gi dge ba rnams yin la/ de yang thos bsam sgom gsum la 'bad cing bla ma dang pha ma dang nad pa'i rim gro byed pa/ dkon mchog dang*/ chos smra ba dang yon tan can gyi bsngags pa brjod cing dge ba la dga' ba bsgom pa/ dkon mchog gsum la mchod cing dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo smon byed pa/ bshes gnyen dang bag yod bsten cing nyes pa 'chags pa sogs kyi dge sbyor la brtson par bya'o/ /sems can don byed ni/

byang sems kyis sems can la phan 'dogs pa yin la/ de la don bya ba bcu gcig tu bshad kyang der nges pa ni ma yin te/ byang sems kyis sems can gyi don byed pa'i tshul dpag tu med pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /mdor na sems can la bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas phan pa'i bya ba ci nus bsgrub pa'i phyir da lta nas 'bad cing mi nus pa rnams smon yul du bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gnod byed dang sdug bsngal sogs kyis mi brdzi zhing chos la mos pa shin du brtan pa'i sems pa ni bzod pa'i ngo bo yin la/ de la gnod pa la ji mi snyam pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang len dang*/ chos la chos sems dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gnod byed kyis gnod pa byas pa la bzod pa ste/ ma bzod par khro na nyes dmigs du ma yod pas so/ /spyir yul gang la'ang khro mi rigs shing*/ khyad par grogs tshangs par mtshungs par spyod pa dang*/ byang sems la khong khros na dge ba mang du 'joms pa sogs nyes dmigs shin du che bas khong khro dgag par bya'o/ /de yang da lta gnod pa byas pa'i gang zag zhig la dmigs nas/ 'dis bdag la gnod pa byed pa ni gang gis dbang yin snyam du brtag go /de'i tshe de ltar byed pa de ni nyon mongs pa'i dbang yin par shes nas khro ba dgag /yang dngos su gnod pa ni dbyug pas byas la brgyud nas yang zhe sdang gis rbad pas dngos brgyud gang gi dbang byas kyang gang zag la khro mi rigs la rtsa ba'i rgyu la khro na rang gis sngon gzhan la gnod pa'i 'bras bu yin pas rang gi sngon las la khro rigs kyi/ gang zag de nyid la khro mi rigs so/ /yang gzhan gyis ngan smras byas pa mi bzod snyam na/ de tsam mi bzod na dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal ji ltar bzod snyam du bsam/ sdug bsngal dang len ni/ sdug bsngal de bcos su yod na mi dga' ba byed mi dgos la bcos su med na ni mi dga' ba byas kyang gnod pa las mi phan pa'i tshul bsam/

gzhan yang sdug bsngal yod na/ des yid thar pa las bskul/ dreg pa sel/ sdig la 'dzem/ dge ba bsgrub pa la dga'/ gzhan la snying rje skye ba'i yon tan rnams 'byung bas sdug bsngal 'di ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'dra bar 'dod pa'i gnas so snyam du bsam/ 'di yod na rang gis sngon byas pa'i las ngan gyi 'bras bu mdzad cing*/ sdug bsngal de'am sems can gzhan gyi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa dang du len pa'i blo myong thog nas 'dren pa sogs yon tan mang du 'byung bar bsam mo/ /chos la nges sems ni/ dkon mchog gsum dang las 'bras dang bdag med gnyis sogs dang*/ gsung rab kyi don la thos bsam phyogs ris med par byed par mos pa sogs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ dge ba bsdu ba dang sems can gyi don du sems mngon par spro ba ni brtson 'grus kyi ngo bo yin la/ de la go cha/ dge ba chos sdud/ sems can don byed dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sems can mang bo'i don du lta zhog /sems can gcig gi don du'ang bskal ba chen po grangs med pa'i bar dmyal bar gnas te sangs rgyas bsgrub dgos pa byung yang brtson pa mi gtong ba'o/ /dge ba chos sdud ni/ phyin drug rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir de dag la slob cing dkon mchog mchod pa sogs la brtson pa'o/ /sems can don byed ni/ don bya ba bcu gcig gi sgo nas sems can gyi don la brtson pa'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi mi mthun phyogs la/ da rung long yod snyam nas phyi bshol byed pa'i le lo/ gnas skabs kyi dman pa'i bde ba phra mo la chags shing g.yeng ba'i le lo/ /de 'dra bdag gis mi nus snyam nas sgyid lug pa dang bya dka' ba dang sdug bsngal la 'jigs nas zhum pa'i le lo rnams byung na dgag par bya'o/ /lnga ba ni/ dge ba'i dmigs pa la mi g.yeng bar gnas pa'i sems rtse gcig pa ni bsam gtan gyi ngo bo yin la/ de la lus sems bder gnas/ yon tan mngon grub/

sems can don byed dang gsum/ dang po ni/ lus sems shin sbyangs bskyed pa'i bsam gtan/ gnyis pa ni/ mngon shes sogs yon tan sgrub pa'i bsam gtan/ gsum pa ni/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i bsam gtan no/ /bsam gtan gyi gtso bo zhi lhag gnyis las 'dir zhi gnas bsgom tshul mdor bsdus te bstan pa la/ bsgom pa'i gnas ni/ mthun rkyen rnyed sla ba/ gnas bzang ba/ sa bzang ba sogs kyi yid dang mthun par/ rten gyi gang zag 'dod chung chog shes pa sogs kyi yon tan dang ldan pas/ spyir dmigs pa'i yul mang yang sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang tshogs rdzogs pa sogs kyi dgos pa yod pas na/ sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan dmigs rten du bya ba ni/ stan bde ba la spyod lam tshul mthun gyis 'khod de/ ston pa'i sku brnyan bris 'bur legs pa gcig la yang yang blta zhing de'i mtshan ma bzung nas yid yul du 'char ba goms su bcug ste/ dbu sogs sku'i cha shas gsal gdab/ mthar sku'i spyi yid la byas nas yan lag rags pa rnams cha phyed tsam 'char thub pa byung yang dmigs rten yin pas des chog shes par bya/ gzhung nas bshad pa'i spyod lam brgyad la gnas bzhin par rlung 'gro 'ong nyer gcig sogs bgrang*/ de nas ting nge 'dzin bsgrub pa la mi spro ba'i le lo dang*/ dmigs pa brjed pa dang*/ bying rgod dang*/ 'du byed dang*/ 'du mi byed pa ste nyes pa lnga'i gnyen por brtson 'grus dang*/ 'dun pa dang*/ dad pa dang*/ shin sbyangs dang*/ dran pa dang*/ shes bzhin/ gnyen po 'du byed pa dang*/ 'du mi byed pa'i btang snyoms te 'du byed brgyad bsten pa'i sgo nas bsgrub dgos pas/ de la thog mar ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan mthong ba'i dad pas drang pa'i 'dun pa drag pos/ 'dris par byas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku de gser btso ma lta bu mtshan dpes spras shing 'od zer 'phro ba che chung 'tshams pa zhig sangs rgyas dngos kyi rnam pa rang gi smin 'tshams kyi nam mkhar gsol btab la/

dmigs yul de nyid nges pa'i 'dzin stangs dam pa nges shes kyi ngar thon pa'i gsal cha dang*/ dran pas mi g.yeng pa'i gnas cha brtan po gnyis dang ldan pa'i sgo nas mi brjed par bya/ de'i mu nas bying rgod byung ma byung brtags te skye ba'i grab byed na shes bzhin gyis rig par bya/ dmigs pa'i dwangs cha yod kyang gsal cha dang 'dzin stangs kyi ngar cha'i shugs cung zad zhan du song na bying ba phra mo skyes pa yin pas sems kyi 'dzin stengs bsgrims te bsgom/ gsal cha'i ngar had kyis shor nas dwangs cha tsam las mi 'dug na bying ba rags pa yin pas ngo shes par byas la bzlog thabs bya/ 'dod pa'i yul yid du 'ong ba 'char la khad byung na rgod pa phra mo yin pas sems 'phro grab byed pa bkag nas dmigs par gdags/ 'dod chags kyi rnam pa had kyis byung na rgod pa rags pa yin pas ngos zin par byas nas 'gog /de ltar bying rgod bkag nas grim lhod ran pa'i mtshams zin par byas te rang nyams la dpag nas bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin skyon med 'grub po/ des ma grub na'ang stobs drug gi sgo nas sems gnas dgu dang yid byed bzhi'i rim pas bsgrub pa ni/ thog mar dang po thos pa'i stobs kyis sems gnas dang po dmigs pa la sems 'jog pa bsgrub/ de nas gnyis pa bsam pa'i stobs kyis sems gnas gnyis pa dmigs pa la rgyud du 'jog pa bsgrub/ de nas gsum pa dran pa'i stobs kyis sems gnas gsum pa dmigs pa la blan te 'jog pa dang*/ bzhi pa gong du nye bar 'jog pa bsgrub/ de nas bzhi pa shes bzhin gyi stobs kyis sems gnas lnga ba ting nge 'dzin la dga' ba dul bar byed pa dang*/ drug pa ting nge 'dzin la mi dga' ba 'gog pa zhi ba byed pa bsgrub/ de nas lnga pa brtson 'grus kyi stobs kyi sems gnas bdun pa gnyid rmugs sogs rnam par zhi bar byed pa dang*/ sems gnas brgyad pa bying rgod sogs kyis bar gcod mi nus par rgyun chags su skye ba gcig tu byed pa bsgrub/

de nas drug pa 'dris pa'i stobs kyis sems gnas dgu pa dmigs pa la rang gi rang gis mnyam par 'jog pa zhes bya ba bsgrub po/ de yang sems gnas dang po gnyis kyi skabs su yid byed bzhi'i nang nas bsgrims te 'jug pa'i yid byed dang*/ gsum pa nas bdun pa'i bar chad cing 'jug pa'i yid byed dang*/ brgyad pa'i tshe chad med du 'jug pa'i yid byed dang*/ dgu pa'i dus su rtsol med du 'jug pa'i yid byed kyi skabs so/ /sems gnas dgu pa de nyid zhi gnas rjes mthun pa yin la/ de nas sems shin sbyangs skye zhing de la brten nas lus shin sbyangs skyes pa de'i mthus lus la bde ba'i nyams skye/ de nas sems shin sbyangs kyi bde ba skye'o/ /lus shin sbyangs skyes ma thag tu zhi gnas cung ma thob kyang*/ de nas sems dmigs pa la lhan ner sdod pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang rjes su mthun pa'i shin sbyangs mi g.yo ba thob pa dang mnyam du bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs kyis bsdus pa'i zhi gnas 'grub pa yin la/ gegs sel bogs 'don sogs rgyas par gzhung che ba rnams nas shes par bya'o/ /de 'dra'i zhi gnas de theg pa gnyis ka'i ting 'dzin thun mong ba yin bam gang gi bsam pas zin na de'i byang chub thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /drug pa ni/ brtags pa'i dngos po la chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa ni shes rab kyi ngo bo yin la/ shes rab de rdzogs byang nyid du bsngo ba'i bsngo bas zin nas goms pa yongs su rdzogs pa ni de'i phar phyin te/ sher phyin dang shes rab kyi phar phyin don gcig tu mi 'dod pa ni legs snyam/ de la don dam dang kun rdzob rtogs pa'i shes rab/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i shes rab gsum/ dang po ni/ bdag med pa'i rtogs pa'i shes rab/ gnyis pa ni/ rig pa'i gnas lnga gang rung la mkhas pa'i shes rab/ gsum pa ni/ sems can gyi don legs par bsgrub pa'i shes rab po/

'dir shes rab kyi gtso bo de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab gtan la dbab par bya'o/ /'di la gnyis/ mnyam gzhag dang*/ rjes thob po/ dang po la gnyis/ bdag med gtan la dbab pa dang*/ lhag mthong bsgom tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis/ gang zag gi bdag med dang*/ chos kyi bdag med gtan la 'bebs pa'o/ /dang po la dgag bya nges pa'i gnad sogs bzhi las/ dang po ni/ dper na/ rang la mi zhig gis phan chen po zhig btags pa'am gnod pa chen po zhig byas pa'i tshe/ nga la phan btags byung snyam pa dang*/ gnod pa byas byung snyam pa'i phan gnod bya yul gyi nga tshang ba zhig snying dkyil nas lhang lhang 'char ba yod pas/ de'i tshe ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyi 'dzin tshul gsal lo/ /de da lta med kyang gsal btab ste skyer bcug nas blo'i byings de nga'o snyam pa'i blo ji ltar skyes pa de la dmigs nas/ blo'i zur zhig gis ngar 'dzin des nga de gang du bzung*/ ji ltar bzung snyam du blta/ de ltar bltas pas de res lus kyi steng du yod pa dang res sems kyi steng du yod pa 'dra ba sogs 'char tshul sna tshogs zhig byung ba'i mthar lus sems gnyis dang 'dres pa ltar 'byed mi thub pa 'dra ba zhig gi steng nas/ gang la yang bltos pa med par nga rang gi ngos nas yod pa'i tshugs thub gdod ma nas grub grub pa zhig 'char 'ong ba ngos zin pa ni dgag bya nges pa'i gnad de legs par nges par bya/ gnyis pa ni/ de ltar bzung ba'i nga de/ rang gi lus sems 'di dang gcig dang tha dad gang chung ngam/ de gang rung ma yin pa zhig snyam pa na/ yod phyin gcig dang tha dad gang rung yin dgos pas de gnyis gang rung ma yin pa'i phung gsum med par rtogs pa ni khyab pa nges pa'i gnad/ gsum pa ni/ de 'dra'i nga de lus sems gnyis dang gcig tu grub bam snyam na/ mi 'thad de/ gcig tu grub na dbyer med kyi gcig tu song bas dbyer med kyi gcig pa ni nga zhes lus sems gnyis kyi nye bar len pa po dang*/

nga'i lus sems zhes de'i nye bar blang bya'i khyad par tha dad du med par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /nga lus sems las tha dad med par khas blangs du mi rung lta/ de ltar na nga'i lus nga'i sems zhes pa sogs mi 'thad pas/ lus zhi ba dang sems ni nga'o zhes pa tsam du 'gyur bas phung po 'dor len byed pa'i bdag khas len pa don med du thal ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang nga lus dang gcig yin na mi 'thad de/ shi ba'i 'og tu lus mer bsregs pa'i tshe nga yang mer bsregs dgos pa dang*/ nga phyi mar nying 'tshams sbyor ba'i tshe lus 'di dang bcas bzhin du skye dgos pa sogs su 'gyur ro/ /sems dang gcig yin na'ang mi 'thad de/ nga la mgo rkang lag sogs yod pa bzhin du sems la yang de dag yod par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /yang na/ lus sems gnyis yod pa ltar nga yang mi 'dra ba gnyis yod par 'gyur bas/ de ltar gcig tu ma grub snyam du nges pa ni/ bden pa'i gcig bral nges pa'i gnad do/ /bzhi ba ni/ gcig tu mi rung bas de 'dra'i nga de lus sems gnyis las tha dad do snyam na/ spyir tha snyad tsam du nga lus sems gnyis dang tha dad du 'jog kyang sngar ltar gzhan la rag ma las pa lta bu'i nga de lus sems dang tha dad du grub na'ang mi rung ste/ de lta na rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i tha dad du song bas gtan nas ma 'brel ba'i tha dad du grub par 'gyur ba'i phyir 'di ni lus so/ /'di ni sems mo zhes blos 'dzin rgyur yod pa ltar lus sems so sor bsal ba'i 'og tu 'di ni nga'o zhes 'dzin rgyu yod dgos pa las de mi 'dug pa'i phyir te/ lus sems tshogs pa'i steng nas ngar 'dogs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar dpyad nas nges pa rnyed pa ni bden pa'i du bral nges pa'i gnad do/ /yang na lus sems gnyis kyi dod du gzugs sogs phung po lnga zhes sbyor/ de ltar gnad bzhi'i dpyad pa byas pas sngar ltar rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i tshugs se ba'i nga ma rnyed par stong cham gyis song ba na dbu ma'i lta ba rnyed pa yin gsungs/

gnyis pa ni/ rang gi lus 'di'i steng du yan lag tshogs pa la ma bltos par lus lings po zhig yul steng nas grub grub par 'char ba ngos zin par byas nas de ltar shar ba ltar bzung ba'i lus de/ yan lag rnams dang gcig gam/ tha dad/ dang po ltar na mi 'thad de/ yan lag spyi tsam dang gcig yin na ni lus dang yan lag gcig tu thal bas/ de lta na bya byed thams cad kyang gcig tu 'gyur la/ yan lag so so dang gcig na/ yan lag mang po yod pa de bzhin du lus kyang tshang ba mang po yod par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /tha dad na'ang mi 'thad de/ spyir lus yan lag dang ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad kyang*/ sngar ltar bzung ba'i lus de yan lag rnams dang tha dad na ni de dag la ma bltos par lus grub dgos pas/ yan lag rnams so sor bsal pa'i 'og du da dung yang lus ril bo zhig yod par thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du ka bum sogs chos gzhan la'ang sbyor/ gnyis pa ni/ thog mar gang zag gi bdag med gtan la phab pa ltar nga med pa lhang gis nges pa na dgag bya bkag tsam gyi med dgag la nges shes kyi rgyun 'thud nas mnyam par 'jog cing*/ shugs zhan du song na gnad bzhi'i dpyad pa cung zad re byas nas de ltar du grub pa med snyam du mnyam par bzhag ste/ sngar zhi gnas grub pa yin na/ dpyad bsgom spel mar byas pa'i mthus lhag mthong thob nas zhi lhag zung 'brel du 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa rjes thob tu/ sngar dpyad pa ltar yul steng na med bzhin du/ sgyu ma'i rta glang ltar btags yod ming rkyang tsam du 'char ba zhig 'ong*/ gal te rang bzhin gyis grub par lam lam ltar byung na'ang/ lta ba dran tsam byas nas snang tshul ltar ma grub snyam du thag bcad pa'i dran shes kyis skyong*/ gzhan yang chos gang dang gang yang ming brdas bzhag tsam gyi rten 'byung du nges pa nyid kyis rang bzhin med pa'i tshul la nges shes 'drongs pa dang*/ de ltar nges pa nyid kyis bya byed thams cad 'thad pa'i rten 'byung la nges pa 'dren pa'i tshul shes pa'i sgo nas stong pa rten 'brel gyi don du 'char ba la bslab par bya'o/

/gnyis pa bsdu bzhi la slob tshul ni/ de ltar rang rgyud smin byed kyi phyin drug la bslab nas zang zing sogs sbyin pa gsum gyis 'khor bsdu/ chos gtam sogs kyi snyan par smra bas the tshom gcod pa sogs kyis mgu bar bya/ mngon mtho sogs gdul bya'i blo dang 'tshams par bstan pa'i don spyod pas yang dag pa'i lam la bkri/ rang nyid tshul 'thun bsgrub pa'i don mthun pas de'i don du 'gyur ba'i tshul la bslab par bya'o/ /gsum pa mjug gi rim pa la ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar nyams len byas nas snying po bsgril te nyams su len pa ni/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba sogs bsams nas skyabs sems byas rjes/ tshogs zhing bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i sdig bshags tshogs gsogs la 'bad cing*/ dngos gzhi gtong len spel ba'i byang chub kyi sems dang stong nyid la dmigs pa'i zhi lhag bsgrub pa la gtso bor 'bad pa dang mthar dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo bar bya'o/ /lam spyi'i don bsdu na/ thog mar bshes gnyen bsten pa la 'bad/ de nas dal 'byor gyi skor bsam zhing 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang shi nas ngan 'gror 'khyams tshul bsams te skyabs 'gro'i skor la 'bad/ de nas las 'bras bsams nas stobs bzhi la 'bad do/ /de ltar chung ngu'i chos skor rnams tshags su chud pa na/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsams te 'khor ba las thar 'dod bskyed/ de nas 'khor ba'i rgyu ngos bzung nas de spong 'dod bskyed cing*/ rten 'brel gyi skor la'ang de ltar bya/ de nas 'khor ba las grol byed kyi lam spyi dang so thar la 'bad do/ /de ltar 'bring gi skor rnams tshags su chud pa na/ byams snying rje'i rtsa ba can gyi byang chub kyi sems sbyangs nas spyod pa phyin drug la ci nus su bslab par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i lam gyi rim pa ni rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam srol rmad du byung zhing*/ gsung rab kun gyi gnad don bsdus pa yin pas thos bsam cung zad re byas pas kyang phan yon chen po mang du 'byung ste/

rje'i zhal nas/ gsung rab kun gyi snying po bsdu bsdu ba*/ rlabs chen sdud par nges pas de don bsam/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na nyams len snying por byed par rigs so/ /smras pa/ rgyal ba kun gyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i las/ /shing rta chen po rnams kyi bzhed pa'i srol/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam mchog yid bzhin nor/ /thub bstan rgyal mtshan rtse mor mngon par mchod/ /'dir 'bad las byung dge tshogs gser 'khor ches/ /sgrib gnyis phas rgol g.yul las rnam rgyal te/ /gtan bde bla med byang chub chen po'i sar/ /mngon par spyod pa'i skal bzang myong bar shog /de lta bu'i lam gyi rim pa 'di ni/ phyogs 'di'i mkhas pa chen po bzang bo rgyal mtshan pa'i drung nas lam rim chen mo'i lung dang*/ khyad par slob dpon sems dpa' chen po blo bzang sbyin pa'i sku zhabs nas zhal lung gi dmar 'khrid stsal pa'i tshe/ rang gis zhal lung nas skyes bu chung 'bring gi skor blo 'dzin dang chen po'i skor la de tsam byed pa ma byung yang 'khrid rgyun nyan/ stong 'khor sprul sku dang*/ slob dpon blo bzang don grub pa'i drung nas kyang dmar 'khrid kyi lung rgyun blangs te/ tshig don gyi cha la yid bshad rgyas par byed pa'i rgyun 'thud ma lcogs kyang don gyi gnad dril ba'i rgyun gyi nyams len 'khyer bder bsdus nas 'bad khul byas/ gzhan la nyams 'khrid 'bogs pa sogs kyi sgo nas rgyun rgya cher spel thub pa zhig ma byung yang*/ phyogs 'di'i bstan pa'i mnga' bdag kau shri nang so yes kyis rje bla ma'i legs bshad la brten nas tshul 'di thos bsam gyis thugs su chud pa'i tshe/ lam srol 'di nyid bstan pa'i snying por gzigs nas/ rang phyogs 'dir gzhan 'ga' la'ang phan srid par dgongs te bkas bskul ba dang*/ sdom brtson ri khrod pa grags pa 'od zer gyis kyang rang gi nyams su len par bzhed nas bskul ba'i tshe/

shākya'i dge slong rigs pa smra ba grags pa bshad sgrub kyis rgyal dbang lnga pas/ na tshod ches phra'i sgo nga'i sbubs rgya nas/ /rnam dpyod rtsal kun rdzogs pa rab dka' mod/ /lang tsho'i sgro gshog rgyas kyang bshad sgrub kyi/ /nam mkha' 'phur nus min pa'i bya des ci/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang nyid kyis thos bsam cung zad byas pa'i 'bras rtags zhig kyang dgos snyam nas dmar 'khrid 'jam dpal zhal lung gi dgongs pa gtso bor byas shing lam rim gnyis nas zur brgyan ha cang bshad yams su song na dmigs pa'i thog tu 'dril dka' bar mthong nas don gyi gnad ma chad pas mdor bsdus te co ne ting 'dzin dar rgyas gling tu sbyar ba'o/ /'dis kyang chos kyi rgyal bo tsong kha ba chen po'i bstan pa la phan par gyur cig /bkra shis// //
